payload.evidence_label: estimated from the calibrated lower-memory coefficient
notes: Only artefacts selected by the resolved release profile are counted.
Cache mode and allowance follow serve's resolved release settings. Cache ceilings do not allocate storage at startup; on-demand snapshot growth is excluded from both startup estimates.

memory_estimate.reason: Conservative startup estimate. The configured cache retention ceiling is not allocated at startup; on-demand cache and snapshot growth are not included. Full-context retention is not verified.

reference_coefficient.conditions: Executor only, one 262144-token session; vision is a separate term.
reference_coefficient.source_path: Bubo memory model, calibrated on Strix Halo 128 GB

memory_estimate.recommendation_reason: Cache can grow to 8.000 GiB; 9.723 GiB left >= margin 5.000 GiB GPU headroom. Host spill 5.351 GiB; 4.204 GiB left >= floor 4.000 GiB.
memory_estimate.formula: GPU: weights + session_state_total + scratch_phase_allowance + device_cache_snapshot_allowance; session_state_total includes executor and separate vision state; reserve sizes snapshot pool only; host: process + NPU staging + host_cache_snapshot_allowance + floor

recommended_context.margin_rule: max(5 GiB, 5% of GPU available) after cache growth at the engine clamp; host free after spill must retain its floor. Snapshot reserve is not admission memory.
